_notes: High-fidelity couch profile for the tuned mpv engine (set-playback-engine.sh mpv-hifi).
4K SDR hi-fi: prefers high-bitrate SDR 4K (HEVC REMUX/encode) for native-4K fidelity that stays smooth on the X11/Pi 5 stack.

exclude_hdr on the 4K steps drops HDR above 1080p: X11 cannot output HDR, so a 4K HDR frame would be GPU tone-mapped to SDR every frame and the Pi 5 cannot sustain that at 4K (heavy stutter). HDR titles fall through to a 1080p step, where tone-mapping is cheap.

Ranking preference (resolution-dominant, decodability tiebreak, nothing excluded): 4K is always preferred when present. Within the 4K tier the HW-decodable HEVC steps (4k_sdr_remux_cached, 4k_sdr_cached) come first, then 4k_sdr_soft_cached admits SDR 4K AV1/H.264 ABOVE the 1080p steps — so a thin title whose only release is 4K AV1 (e.g. India's Got Latent) still auto-plays at 4K rather than failing, and a title that also has 4K HEVC always gets the smooth one. last_resort remains the final catch-all (HDR/uncached/any codec).

The Pi 5 soft-decodes 4K AV1/H.264 with CPU headroom (marginal, not a hard wall), so 4k_sdr_soft_cached accepts it. Cross-resolution order is owned here by step order; within-tier HEVC>AV1 is reinforced by the hardware-decode tiebreaker in streamPlayScore.
REMUX is confined to the 4K steps; 1080p stays on efficient encodes to avoid high-bitrate AVC software-decode load.
Cached-only (include_uncached=false) so debrid serves the high bitrate fast enough to avoid rebuffering.
